setup: INSERT INTO topic_tags (topic_id, tag_id, created_at, updated_at) SELECT t.id, 1, now(), now() FROM topics t WHERE t.archetype = 'private_message' AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND t.id IN (SELECT topic_id FROM topic_allowed_users WHERE user_id = 3) ORDER BY t.id LIMIT 1
UPDATE tags SET pm_topic_count = 1 WHERE id = 1
